english.title: Use a vehicle on an unrestricted dual carriageway road when not every warning beacons fitted were working
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on an unrestricted dual carriageway road, namely **(..SPECIFY DUAL CARRIAGEWAY ROAD..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when not every warning beacon required to be fitted by regulation 17 of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989 was kept lit
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 26of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) This offence wording relates to the use of obligatory amber warning beacons on vehicles. For the misuse of optional warning beacons see H3093 in relation to flashing lamps/beacons and H273, H299 and H300 in relation to coloured lamps/reflectors/beacons other than red showing to the rear of the vehicle.
(ii) See regulation 17(2) for exceptions.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H3098 and H3099.
(v) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
